NodeProof.description:
Proof of the node key, carried by `hello`.

The signature covers the whole `hello` body with `proof.signature` removed,
under the context line `meridian.agent/v1 hello`. The service checks the
certificate chain, revocation, the SAN against `fleet_id`/`node_id`, that
`issued_at` is within 300 seconds of its clock, and that `nonce` is unused.

issued_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC, ending in Z.
issued_at.title: Issued At

signature.description: Ed25519 signature (64 bytes) in standard base64.
signature.title: Signature

NodeStateRef.description: Points at one desired-state document by epoch, revision, and content hash.

fleet_epoch.description: Fleet epoch. A restore of the control service bumps it. An agent remembers the highest epoch it accepted and refuses desired state and commands from an older one (a resurrected old control server).
fleet_epoch.title: Fleet Epoch

revision.description: Desired-state revision for one node. Ordering is (fleet_epoch, revision): within an epoch revisions only grow; a higher epoch wins even with a lower revision.
revision.title: Revision

description: Opens a session and negotiates protocol and capabilities.

agent_version.description: Version string as its upstream publishes it, for example 26.7.11 or v2.9.6.
agent_version.title: Agent Version

applied.description: Last desired state fully applied; `null` before the first.

items.description: A capability name. Names the receiver does not know are ignored, never rejected.

fleet_id.description: Fleet identifier: a lowercase UUID fixed when the fleet is created.
fleet_id.title: Fleet Id

anyOf.description: Fleet epoch. A restore of the control service bumps it. An agent remembers the highest epoch it accepted and refuses desired state and commands from an older one (a resurrected old control server).

highest_fleet_epoch.description: Highest epoch the agent has accepted; a service on an older epoch answers `epoch_superseded`.
highest_fleet_epoch.title: Highest Fleet Epoch

node_id.description: Node identifier: the server's lowercase topology ID, unique within the fleet.
node_id.title: Node Id

protocols.description: Protocol versions the agent speaks; if none is the service's, it answers `unsupported_protocol`.
protocols.title: Protocols
